_meta.comment: UI text snippets of the members area (members.html) grouped by the headline/title of the section they appear in. The group name is sent as translation context alongside each snippet in the challenge worker's batch translation challenges (kind=translations). Groups starting with '_' are metadata. Mirrors dist/js/snippets/chat.context.json.
